basic_info.main_problem: 作为一名正在预订本地演出的歌手,我not断觉得这些not会通向更大的事业,这种思维模式正在引发压力与Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts are affecting my confidence, performance quality, and overall well-being.

special_situations.event: The moment before going on stage at a local show
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这次演出without法很快带来更大的舞台或机会,就说明我的职业前景注定not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试保持积极,专注当下以对冲Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次也not会带来更大的事业,努力都是徒劳

special_situations.event: 在演出前或准备期间想到行业里更成功的Musician并进行比较
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我达not到那些更成功Musician的水平,就证明I am not good enough,也not会有前途
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少向朋友敞露Self-doubt与Fear,以避免被评判或显得脆弱
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Receiving audience praise or positive feedback after performances
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非获得行业层面的重大成功,否则零散的赞美not算数,对整体毫Meaninglessness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 轻描淡写或negate小成就,以维持'理性大局观'

special_situations.event: 回顾职业进展时,注意力集中在not足与not确定的not yet来
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative information is more real and reliable; only major breakthroughs count as progress
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过强调行业竞争与自身not足来'保持现实',忽略当前的具体进展
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管现在做得怎样,not yet来依然很糟

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可,拥有更大的Career development与成功
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与自I am not good enough被暴露,担心希望被打破后更失望
defense_goal: 少向他人谈及Self-doubt以避免被评判或显得脆弱

object_relations.self_representation: not够好且前景渺茫的歌手

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to attend to positive feedback and small achievements (such as audience praise, performances booked)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些只是微not足道,放在'大局'里not算数,是自我安慰
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气平静但坚持,强调'行业竞争激烈,这些not重要',举例说明他人更成功以支持自己的判断.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当想到向支持性朋友敞露Self-doubt与Fear,寻求情感支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心被评判或麻烦他人,认为not应开启这类话题
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 简短回应如'我not太谈这些',回避细节,语气克制,话题快速Displacement.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked before a performance about expectations for the performance or prospects
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views failure as inevitable; considers positive expectations self-deception
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use绝对化陈述(如'永远not会有更大的事业'),语气坚决,直接negate可能性.

manifestations: 在本地演出后将观众的赞美视为在'大局'里微not足道
认为目前努力not会通往更大的事业
难以向支持性的朋友敞露Self-doubt与Fear
outcomes: 关系中的Withdrawal与Increased sense of alienation

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes the standard of 'must achieve greater success to count' using more successful people in the industry as the benchmark
将'小成就not算数'视为理所当然的规则

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When facing audience praise, quickly shifts to the 'big picture' and the fact that others are more successful, avoiding contact with the positive experience of the moment
Finds it hard to directly respond to and open up to friends' support, instead staying silent or expressing vaguely

exception_events.target_problem: 在本地演出前后,来访者通常会被Self-doubt与Anxiety困住,并在回顾时negate自己的进步与正向反馈.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 某次演出后收到观众的具体赞美,当下短暂地感到被肯定与有潜力,与以往迅速negate的反应not同.
exception_events.reason: not同支持:现场观众给出具体正向反馈;情境线索:演出结束后的即时赞美使注意力短暂停留在当下体验而非'宏观比较'.
